turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Of course. First, here is one example, step by step.
I work in the morning. She works in the morning.
Step 1: Who? "She".
Step 2: After "she", I add -s to the verb: works.
Rule: after he, she or it, add -s to the verb.
Right: He works at home. Wrong: He work at home.

Now you try. Write only the verb:
Write the correct form: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. (answer with only the verb)
